# Color guardrails

Narrative and step tables live in `DESIGN.md` §2. This rule only constrains agent behavior.

* **MUST**: Use `--accent-{1–12}` and `--gray-{1–12}` (and alpha variants `--accent-a*`, `--gray-a*`). Prefer semantic tokens (`--primary`, `--accent-surface`, `--accent-contrast`, …) when available.
* **MUST**: Map roles by step — 1–2 backgrounds, 3–5 interactive fills, 6–8 borders/focus, 9–10 solid brand, 11–12 text.
* **MUST**: Keep steps 11–12 at APCA Lc 60 / Lc 90 targets on step 2 backgrounds.
* **MUST NOT**: Ship one-off hex or raw palette utilities (`bg-pink-500`, marketing sample hex) as production source of truth.
* **SHOULD**: Map `--primary` to `--accent-9`. On transparent defaults, hover may use step 3.
